content_sections.heading: NCHMCT LDC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The NCHMCT Lower Division Clerk selection process consists of a written examination followed by a skill test for shortlisted candidates. The written examination includes objective questions covering four subjects, along with a drafting assessment. In addition to the 100 multiple-choice questions, the written test includes drafting a letter, notice or note for 30 marks. Candidates shortlisted after the written examination will undergo a typing skill test and computer proficiency test. The essential eligibility criteria specify a typing speed of 30 words per minute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Offline for NCHMCT LDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application form along with copies of the necessary supporting documents to the NCHMCT office in Noida. The application must reach the office on or before 30 November 2026. Visit the official NCHMCT website at www.nchm.gov.in . Download the prescribed application form for the Lower Division Clerk recruitment. Fill in the required personal and educational details. Attach copies of documents supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience and category, wherever applicable. Place the completed application form and supporting documents in an envelope. Write "Application for the post of LDC" on the top of the envelope. Send the application to the postal address mentioned below. Ensure that the application reaches NCHMCT by 30 November 2026. The Director (A&F) National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT) A-34, Sector 62 Noida - 201309 Uttar Pradesh Last Date for Receipt of Application: 30 November 2026 Candidates employed in Central or State Government departments, autonomous bodies or public sector undertakings must apply through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT) for filling up vacant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this NCHMCT notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the post of Lower Division Clerk under advertisement number NCHM-01/2026-ADMIN.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Lower Division Clerk post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th of 10+2 system or equivalent with a typing speed of 30 w.p.m. with at least one year experience. Ability to use a computer is an essential qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for the post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 27 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30 November 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it out, and send it by post along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form should be sent to The Director (A&F), NCHMCT, A-34, Sector 62, Noida 201 309, with the envelope superscribed as 'Application for the post of LDC'.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NCHMCT LDC?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test consisting of 100 MCQs (Numeric Aptitude, General English, General Knowledge, Clerical Aptitude) and letter/notice/note drafting, followed by a Typing Skill Test / Computer Proficiency Test.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Lower Division Clerk post will receive a salary as per Pay Level 2 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
